bias.en: Downtrend · new low under $122.2, MACD crossed down
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $122.2 创新低，MACD 下穿

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 7.3% on Nov 16 to $122.18, trading $121.94–125.94. It is below the 5-day ($132.7), 10-day ($134.3) and 30-day ($146.6), all falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 91 sessions). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 16, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($160.28), and RSI is 37.7.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月16日下跌 7.3%，收于 $122.18，盘中区间 $121.94–125.94。股价位于 5 日（$132.7）、10 日（$134.3）和 30 日均线（$146.6）下方，三者均在下行（上市仅 91 个交易日，尚无 100、200 日均线）。MACD 于 11月16日下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$160.28），RSI 为 37.7。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, including the Nov 5 low ($122.20), now resistance; the $121.94 low is the lowest since listing. Resistance is $122.2–123.9 (Nov 5 low and close), then $124.8–127.4 (Nov 6 low and close, Nov 16 high, Nov 10 low) and $129.2–130.8. Support is $121.9 (Nov 16 low), then the round $120. A close above $125.9 would target $127.4–129.7; below $121.9, $120.
read.zh: 此次下跌跌破此前全部三档支撑，包括 11月5日低点（$122.20），转为阻力；盘中低点 $121.94 为上市以来最低。阻力为 $122.2–123.9（11月5日低点和收盘），其次 $124.8–127.4（11月6日低点和收盘、11月16日高点、11月10日低点）和 $129.2–130.8。支撑为 $121.9（11月16日低点），其次 $120 整数关口。若收盘站上 $125.9，下一目标看 $127.4–129.7；若跌破 $121.9，则看 $120。

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul bar is flat at ₩1,120,000, carrying the Nov 15 close; that session fell 7.9% from ₩1,216,000, trading ₩1,113,000–1,222,000. The close is below the falling 5-day (₩1,197,400), 10-day (₩1,212,700), 30-day (₩1,350,500) and 100-day (₩1,702,600) and the rising 200-day (₩1,523,200). MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 15, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,458,200), and RSI is 35.7.

Since the previous read the close broke all three written supports (₩1,132,000–1,212,000: Nov 12 low, Oct 22 low, Nov 5 and 8 closes), now resistance; the ₩1,113,000 low held above the Nov 5 low. Resistance is ₩1,132,000–1,136,000, then ₩1,171,000 (Oct 22 low) and ₩1,197,400–1,212,700 (5-day, Nov 12 low, 10-day). Support is ₩1,113,000–1,116,000, then ₩1,089,000 (Nov 5 low) and ₩1,000,000. A close above ₩1,136,000 would target ₩1,171,000; below ₩1,113,000, ₩1,089,000.
